title: Senior Recruiter – Trade Sales Hiring
description:
### **About Us**

Global, inclusive and innovative - welcome to AMS, where talent connects across cultures and backgrounds to shape the future of work.

We work with leading organizations to design and deliver talent strategies that bring together people, process, data and technology, helping millions of people find meaningful work every year. Our diverse, connected community collaborates to create results for clients and opportunities for our people to learn, grow and make an impact.

At AMS, we look for people who bring more than experience, and we welcome different perspectives and ways of thinking.

  

### **The Role**

We are looking for a Senior Recruiter with strong expertise in hiring for Trade Sales roles (General Trade & Modern Trade) within the manufacturing sector. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of sourcing and closing sales talent across distribution, channel, and retail-facing functions, working closely with regional and zonal business leaders.

### **Key Accountabilities**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for General Trade (GT) and Modern Trade (MT) sales roles — from Territory Sales Officer to Regional/Zonal Sales Manager level
* Partner with Sales Leadership, Regional Business Heads, and HRBPs to understand hiring needs across territories and zones
* Drive pan-India hiring for field sales roles, including remote/on-ground hiring drives in Tier 2/3 towns and rural markets
* Source and build talent pipelines for niche sales profiles — Key Account Managers, Distributor Sales Managers, Channel Sales Managers
* Conduct market mapping of competitor organizations (FMCG, consumer durables, beverages) to benchmark sourcing strategy
* Manage high-volume hiring for junior/mid-level field sales roles alongside niche/leadership hiring for senior sales positions
* Coordinate interviews, manage offer negotiations, and ensure smooth onboarding, including for candidates in remote locations
* Track and report hiring metrics (TAT, offer-to-join ratio, source-wise effectiveness) to leadership
* Build and maintain strong vendor relationships for regional/local hiring support where needed
* Ensure compliance with company hiring policies and budget/compensation guidelines across territories

### **Skills & Requirements**

* 5–10 years of recruitment experience, with significant exposure to Trade Sales hiring (GT/MT) in manufacturing, FMCG, or consumer durables
* Proven experience hiring across multiple geographies/territories, including rural/semi-urban markets
Strong understanding of sales hierarchy and career paths within trade sales (TSO ASM RSM* ZSM)
* Excellent stakeholder management skills — ability to work with regional sales leadership across zones
* Hands-on experience with ATS platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, and other sourcing channels
* Ability to manage high-volume + niche hiring simultaneously
* Strong negotiation and offer management skills

### **Why AMS?**

At AMS, we come from every walk of life - and that’s what makes us unique. Our culture is open, inclusive and built on trust. We empower our people with the flexibility and autonomy to work in ways that bring out their best. We offer career opportunities in every direction you want to explore.

**We offer**

* Growth and development focused on your strengths
* The opportunity to develop a career within one of the world’s leading organisations specialising in talent and workforce solutions.
* A team that values being Passionate, Bold, and Authentic
* Supportive communities such as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
* Volunteer day - you get one additional paid day off each year to volunteer for a cause that matters to you
* A competitive reward and benefits package\* (private medical care, life insurance, etc.)
* Flexibility in how and where you work\*
* Hybrid model [when applies - details]

  

* Details may vary slightly depending on your location, local labour law, etc.

**Our statement**

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people with diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate based upon age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

If you require any accommodations or have any accessibility needs, please reach out via email [email protected] or make a member of our Talent Acquisition team aware at any time.

If you’re ready to bring your skills, curiosity, and passion, click **Apply** and let’s explore what we can achieve together!

**Company:** Spectra Solar Power

**Department:** Human Resources & Operations

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Spectra Solar Power**

At **Spectra Solar Power**, we are driving India’s transition toward clean, sustainable energy. Specializing in residential and Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Solar EPC solutions, we are rapidly scaling our footprint across key states. We are looking for an energetic and goal-driven **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to help build and scale our cross-functional teams—from high-volume field sales to technical engineering personnel.

**Role Overview**

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will manage end-to-end recruitment across sales, technical, project management, and corporate verticals. You will be responsible for sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding top talent to keep pace with our aggressive growth plans.

**Key Responsibilities1. Sourcing & Pipeline Building**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment cycles for technical (Solar Engineers, Project Managers, Supply Chain) and non-technical roles (B2C/B2B Direct Sales, State Heads, Back-office ops).
* Utilize multiple channels including LinkedIn, job portals (Naukri, Indeed), social media, campus drives, and local walk-in events to source quality profiles.
* Organize and coordinate high-volume walk-in drives across key regional hubs.

**2. Interviewing & Assessment**

* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, and assess candidates on functional expertise, cultural fit, and CTC/notice period expectations.
* Brief candidates on technical and market expectations (e.g., PM Surya Ghar Yojana knowledge, EPC operations, tier-1 panel ecosystems) prior to business rounds.
* Schedule and align interview loops with key hiring managers and department heads.

**3. Offer & Onboarding Operations**

* Manage offer rollouts, salary negotiations, and pre-boarding documentation (e.g., candidate information forms, salary slip verification).
* Track pipeline metrics, notice periods, and candidate drop-out rates to minimize hiring gaps.
* Facilitate smooth day-one onboarding in coordination with the HR Operations team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:** 6months to 1 years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition (agency or in-house).
* **Industry Preference:** Prior experience hiring for **Solar EPC**, Renewable Energy, Real Estate, Construction, Telecom, or High-Volume B2C Direct Sales is a major plus.
* **Tools:** Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, Job Portals, Google Workspace/MS Office, and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
* **Skills:** Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.

**What We Offer**.

* Opportunity to work in the fast-growing clean energy sector.
* Fast-track career growth within a high-speed, expanding HR setup.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

**SAP Analytics Cloud Developer – Specialist - Hyderabad**
==========================================================

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Developer – Senior Analyst will develop, enhance, and support reporting and analytics solutions for Global Finance Services. The role is primarily focused on hands-on SAC story and dashboard development, data modeling, testing, documentation, and production support.

The Senior Analyst will work within established architecture, security, and governance standards to translate finance and operational requirements into accurate, intuitive, and reliable analytics products.

The successful candidate will collaborate with business analysts, data teams, quality assurance teams, and reporting stakeholders to deliver solutions, resolve issues, and support continuous improvement.

**Work You’ll Do**
------------------

As part of the Global Finance Services Reporting and Analytics team, you will build and support SAC solutions that convert business requirements and complex data into clear, actionable insights. You will contribute to the modernization of reporting by applying established development standards and delivering scalable, user-focused analytics products.

* Develop, enhance, and maintain SAP Analytics Cloud stories, dashboards, and analytical applications based on defined business requirements.
* Transform finance and operational reporting requirements into intuitive visualizations, metrics, filters, drilldowns, and interactive features.
* Build and maintain SAC data models using dimensions, measures, hierarchies, calculations, and reusable business logic.
* Connect and validate data from SAP sources such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW, SAP HANA, and SAP Datasphere, as well as approved non-SAP sources.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, testing, and defect resolution to ensure reporting accuracy and reliability.
* Troubleshoot data, connectivity, refresh, performance, and user-access issues and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.
* Support dashboard performance tuning by optimizing calculations, filters, queries, and data-refresh processes.
* Apply established security, role-based access, development, and governance standards.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, quality assurance teams, subject matter experts, and end users throughout the development lifecycle.
* Prepare technical documentation, data definitions, test evidence, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Support deployments, production validation, maintenance, and enhancement activities.
* Provide work estimates, communicate progress and risks, and manage assigned deliverables with guidance from team leaders.

**Work Location and Shift**
---------------------------

**Work Location: India, Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 2:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.**

**Required Qualifications and Skills**
--------------------------------------

* 3–6 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, or enterprise reporting solutions.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, including story and dashboard development, data models, calculations, filters, input controls, and linked analysis.
* Working knowledge of dimensional and semantic data-modeling concepts, including dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and calculated measures.
* Experience using SAP data sources such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW, SAP HANA, or SAP Datasphere.
* Proficiency in SQL and experience with data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of finance reporting concepts, including actuals, budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, and management reporting.
* Experience with requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
* Ability to troubleshoot data-quality, performance, refresh, connectivity, and user-access issues.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities and deliver quality work within established timelines and standards.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Exposure to SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, or related SAP cloud data and analytics services.
* Experience with SAC planning capabilities, including versions, data actions, allocations, forecasting, or scenario modeling.
* Experience with Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence, or another enterprise visualization platform.
* Familiarity with SAP BW queries, CompositeProviders, ADSOs, InfoObjects, SAP HANA calculation views, or related SAP data structures.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, Power Query, or Power Pivot.
* Relevant SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP BW, SAP HANA, or SAP Business Data Cloud certification.
* Experience working with global, virtual, or cross-functional teams.

**Portfolio Submission**
------------------------

* Candidates may provide one or two examples of dashboards or analytics solutions they have developed using SAP Analytics Cloud or a comparable enterprise reporting tool.

* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to explain technical information in practical business terms.

The **Senior Product Manager, Data Ingestion and Customer Onboardin**g is responsible for defining the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Vertex's data ingestion and customer onboarding capabilities. This role owns how customer data is collected, transformed, validated, and activated across Vertex products, ensuring customers achieve value quickly and efficiently. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partner teams, this role delivers scalable solutions that improve customer adoption, reduce onboarding complexity, and strengthen platform data capabilities.

* Define and own product vision, strategy, and roadmap for data ingestion and customer onboarding; align priorities with company objectives, customer needs, and platform strategy while balancing strategic investments, customer commitments, and technical debt.
* Own the end-to-end customer onboarding experience from initial setup through successful product adoption; identify friction points, drive improvements that reduce implementation effort, and define success metrics for adoption, activation, and customer health.
* Define capabilities for data ingestion, mapping, validation, transformation, monitoring, and governance; understand integration technologies including APIs, connectors, and ETL/ELT processes to deliver scalable, reusable ingestion services and onboarding automation.
* Translate business requirements into detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; manage and prioritize the product backlog and partner with Engineering through the full development lifecycle, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning.
* Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support teams to continuously improve onboarding outcomes and reduce operational overhead; partner with platform teams to deliver automation and reusable onboarding solutions.
* Engage directly with customers through interviews, workshops, and strategic discussions; demonstrate product capabilities to customers, prospects, and partners; communicate roadmap updates and product outcomes to leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Engineering teams; build and maintain alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and Partner organizations.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS, enterprise software, platform, or data-centric environment.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing product roadmaps; ability to evaluate trade-offs, assess technical constraints, and prioritize across competing business and customer needs.
* Experience writing detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; hands-on proficiency with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Working knowledge of data integration concepts including APIs, connectors, and ETL/ELT processes; ability to engage credibly with Engineering teams on data ingestion and platform integration topics.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; demonstrated ability to evaluate complex trade-offs and make prioritization decisions grounded in data and customer impact.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to present priorities, roadmap decisions, and product outcomes clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Product organizations to deliver cross-functional outcomes.

* Familiarity with enterprise software ecosystems such as ERP, CRM, eCommerce, procurement, or finance platforms and their integration patterns with data platforms.
* Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and observability concepts; experience defining approaches for handling data exceptions and ensuring ingestion reliability.
* Experience with cloud-based platforms and modern SaaS architectures; understanding of scalable data platform and service design.
* Experience supporting customer demonstrations, workshops, and enterprise implementation engagements.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a formal degree.

title: Lead, Technical Services Engineer - Partners
description:
MongoDB's Technical Services Engineering team uses exceptional problem-solving and customer service skills, along with deep technical experience, to advise customers and solve their complex MongoDB problems: consulting on application and schema design, optimizing performance and scalability, resolving production outages, designing and reviewing operational procedures such as business continuity plans, and explaining MongoDB internals.

As Lead, Technical Services Engineer, Partners, you will mentor, train, and coach a team of Partner TSEs while remaining hands-on with the most complex partner and mutual-customer issues. You will work with the team Manager and take on day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, ensuring caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, with a constant focus on customer and partner success. You will also collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile partners and customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

### **Required**

* 2+ years of experience leading teams, directly or indirectly
* Patience, empathy, and a genuine desire to help others
* ~7 years of experience building, managing, and maintaining complex, mission-critical, large-scale production database systems (RDBMS, NoSQL, or both).
* Coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, JavaScript, Node.js, Go, etc.
* Experience working with APIs to integrate with 3rd-party technologies and software in areas such as security and fraud, big data analytics and AI, healthcare, content management, IoT, database performance monitoring and management, financial services, and telco
* Solid hands-on systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting process, with significant experience analyzing and troubleshooting end-to-end issues holistically in production, from the application tier through the database down to storage
* Troubleshooting experience with the TCP/IP networking stack on OS and hypervisor, including firewalls and load balancers
* Experience using or administering one or more cloud stacks such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting NAS, SAN, local storage, and multi-pathing
* Experience building solutions involving application workloads and use cases
* Strong background in performance tuning and benchmarking, and in providing technical support to internal and/or external customers
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure, and find solutions in real time

### **Preferred**

* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience developing applications in one or more programming languages using a NoSQL or SQL database
* Strong understanding of authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, and AD
* Experience with distributed version control systems, in particular git
* Experience with Kubernetes or other orchestration systems using vendor-specific Enterprise operators
* Experience working with software product teams, and familiarity with product release processes from planning to release

### **Success Measures**

* In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its partner ecosystem, completed New Hire Training, and built working relationships with your team, the Manager, and key partner and internal stakeholders
* In 6 months, you will be running day-to-day team operations (workflow, escalations, meetings) with the Manager, comfortable working frontline with customers and partners, and will have completed the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
* In 12 months, you will be a recognized technical specialist and people leader: your team's engineers are growing and independently handling technical escalations, partner Centers of Excellence are in place for onboarded partners, and you are driving regular pain and bug reporting and operational improvements with Engineering and internal teams

### **Responsibilities**

Team leadership and operations

* Drive customer and partner success by guiding the team to solve complex technical problems, from design through production operations, including managing team workflow, assisting on hands-on customer issues, and managing internal and external escalations
* Work with the team Manager to assume day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, including hiring, training, mentoring, coaching, meetings, and performance evaluations
* Ensure caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, and actively monitor partner-related cases to ensure correct handling
* Contribute to internal technical projects, which can include software development, benchmarking, building documentation and training guides, and providing oversight on other engineers' project work
* Ensure we are investing the right resources, addressing the right problems, and scaling the organization properly: drive monthly and quarterly pain and bug reports to Engineering, improve operational workflows with internal teams at MongoDB, coordinate regional trainings, summits, and conferences, and help address market demand for our product and services more broadly

Direct partner support

* Provide in-market support for technology partners to ensure good customer outcomes
* Provide development support through the Design-Win process, helping partners get to market via MongoDB best practices and solution interoperability guidance
* Act as the domain expert and context source for partner-related matters, and facilitate partner engagement as needed
* Onboard partners: document contacts, establish escalation paths, and set up communication channels (Slack, recurring review and check-in cadence)
* Lead Partners Center of Excellence work per onboarded partner: build a partner-specific knowledge base, perform technology reviews of the partner's solution and integration, review partner solution releases for known MongoDB issues, maintain as-built documentation (deployment architecture, product/solution matrix, known issues), communicate best practices, and build a risk mitigation plan

Support for joint and mutual customers

* Lead multi-vendor collaboration when an issue's root cause spans multiple vendors
* Manage mutual support systems and case-handling processes
* Manage partner escalation contacts and processes
* Collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications

Program-level objectives the role serves

* Centralized point of contact within Technical Services for partner-account support matters
* Knowledge hub within TS for all partner-related information
* Minimizing technical-interoperability risk for mutual customers
* Champion the customer's and partner's needs and contribute to the evolution of our Developer Data Platform

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The **Search & Referrals team** owns Tide's marketing website and leads the expansion of our referral programme. We are responsible for designing growth loops, scaling user acquisition initiatives, and building product experiences that contribute to Tide's growth. You will work closely with the team to deliver impactful solutions across Tide's marketing and referral experiences.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

As a **Staff Mobile Engineer** at Tide you will be working on the designing, creating and running the rich product catalogue in one of our **Business** **areas,** working across multiple teams. We have a long roadmap ahead of us and rarely run out of interesting problems to tackle.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our engineers to **make real technical decisions** **that affect multiple teams** and shape the future of Tide's Global **One Platform**.

We work in small autonomous teams, grouped under common domains owning the micro-frontends that makes Tide a great application. We self-organise, gather together to discuss technical challenges, and set our own guidelines on our **Community of Practice** regardless of where one currently stands in our Growth Framework. We are focused on delivering a **WOW**! experience whilst ensuring a **resilient**, **error-free** and **scalable** codebase.

As a Staff Mobile Engineer you'll be:

* You will be learning and sharing knowledge with our engineers on new things often, as we believe in experimentation, T-shaped engineering and collaborative learning for career growth.
* You will be working on defining vision and strategies on how we build products for our Business Areas. We have an exciting roadmap with brand new features and we will need you to solve interesting problems.
* Act as a supportive and enthusiastic technical lead, by advocating for best practices on how we deliver the best software for our members based on data while contributing to the wellbeing of the team.
* Joining one of our expanding multi-disciplinary agile teams, you will work together with product owners, UI/UX designers, architects, engineers, and other business members to translate requirements into well-engineered solutions.
* You will join our **Flutter Community of Practices**, and your input on how to improve processes and maintain high quality across the team will be very welcome.
* Career progression is as important to us as it is for you, and we, therefore, have put in place a Tide Growth Framework to guide you. With our expanding teams and business, we will encourage you to outgrow your initial responsibilities, if you so desire.

Our company is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, that fosters cooperation in everything we do. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference with responsibilities across engineering practices in a supportive and rapidly expanding company!

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* You have several years of experience as a Software Engineer working with Flutter, native mobile (iOS or Android), or React Native.
* You have experience with popular Flutter libraries, tools and its lifecycle.
* You are passionate about building great products in small, autonomous, agile teams.
* You have a passion for automation tests and experience writing testable code.
* You have experience building sleek, high-performance user interfaces and complex Mobile apps that successfully shipped to customers.
* Experience technically leading Mobile engineers within cross-platform teams, with the ability to develop and mentor less-experienced developers.
* Experience leveraging automation and tooling, focused on Continuous Integration, Delivery and Deployment.

**OUR TECH STACK**

* We utilise the latest iterations of **Flutter** and **Dart**.
* We use popular and trusted plugins, packages, and tools, preferring leveraging existing solutions over reinventing the wheel.
* We adopt a modular approach in building our applications, viewing each small package akin to a Lego block. More on our approach can be found here.
* With **Melos**, we handle an extensive Dart codebase, featuring over 300 packages and around 2 million lines of code.
* We manage state and dependency injection efficiently using **flutter\_bloc**, **get\_it** and **injectable**.
* Our application navigation leverages **auto\_route** and **flow\_builder**.
* We approach the backend communication implementation using **freezed**, **json\_serializable**, **retrofit**, and **dio** interceptors. More about this approach here.
* We heavily rely on code generation with **mason** and **build\_runner**.
* **i69n** is our tool of choice for localisation. You can find how we do it here.
* We're deeply committed to Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) tests, and we use **bdd\_widget\_test** to help us on that. You can find more here.
* **Firebase Suite**, **DataDog**, **LaunchDarkly**, and **Segment** assist us in tracking, monitoring, and deploying securely.
* Our CI/CD pipelines and weekly releases are facilitated by **GitHub** and **GitHub actions.**

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* **Competitive Compensation -** competitive salary and share options
* **Time Off –** Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* **Parental Leave –** Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* **Sabbatical –** Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* **Health Insurance –** Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* **Life & Accident Cover –** Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* **Mental Wellbeing –** Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* **Volunteering & Development Days –** Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* **Learning & Development –** Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* **WOO (Work Outside the Office) –** Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* **Home Office Setup –** Contribution towards setting up your home office
* **Laptop Ownership –** Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
* **Snacks & Meals –** Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.

Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on.

We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents.

In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person.

You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right.

* Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment.
* Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the team's practice as the tooling changes.
* Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention.

title: Study Abroad Education Consultant
description:
**Job details**

* **Company:** UniEra Consulting
* **Location:** Remote
* **Job type:** Full-time
* **Schedule:** Flexible hours, with some evenings and weekends to match student and parent time zones
* **Reports to:** Head of Counseling

**About UniEra**

UniEra Consulting is a global education consulting firm based in Chicago, Illinois. We help international students get into top universities abroad and build their careers after graduation.

Our founders were international students themselves, and our team has worked at firms such as McKinsey, BCG, the Big 4, J.P. Morgan, Google, Amazon and Microsoft. UniEra was formed through a merger of several study-abroad agencies, bringing together 7 years of experience.

We support students from Azerbaijan, Ukraine, India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Türkiye, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the United States. Our services cover Bachelor's, Master's and PhD application support, English as a Second Language (ESL) programs and professional career consultation. Our students have gone on to universities such as Columbia, Purdue and the University of Toronto.

About the role

As an Education Consultant, you guide students and their families from first enquiry to arrival on campus. You match each student to the right country, university and program, then manage their application and visa so nothing is missed. You work remotely with a counseling team and partner institutions across time zones.

**Key responsibilities**

**Student counseling**

* Hold video consultations with students and parents to understand academic background, goals, budget and preferred destinations.
* Recommend a shortlist of countries, universities and programs that fit each student's profile and admission chances.
* Advise on entry requirements, English tests (IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, Duolingo), scholarships and funding options.

**Applications and admissions**

* Manage each application end to end: document checklists, transcripts, recommendation letters and portal submissions.
* Review and give feedback on personal statements, statements of purpose and CVs.
* Track offers and conditions, and help students accept offers and pay deposits on time.

**Visa and pre-departure**

* Guide students through student visa applications for destinations such as the UK, US, Canada, Australia and Europe.
* Check financial documents and prepare students for visa interviews.
* Run pre-departure briefings on accommodation, travel and arrival.

**Pipeline and relationships**

* Respond to new leads quickly and convert enquiries into signed-up students.
* Keep every student record and status up to date in the CRM.
* Stay in contact with partner university admissions teams and keep up with policy and visa rule changes.
* Represent UniEra at virtual fairs, webinars and school sessions.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any field.
* 2+ years in study-abroad counseling, university admissions or international student recruitment.
* Working knowledge of admissions and student visa processes for at least two major destinations (e.g. UK, US, Canada, Australia).
* Excellent written and spoken English; able to explain complex rules simply to students and parents.
* Organised enough to run 40+ active student files at once without missing a deadline.
* Comfortable working remotely: reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and confident with video calls, CRMs and shared documents.
* A student-first approach: honest advice, even when it means recommending a different option.

**Nice to have**

* Personal experience studying abroad.
* Fluency in a second language spoken by our students, such as Russian, Azerbaijani, Turkish, Hindi, Kazakh, Ukrainian or Arabic.
* Certification such as the British Council Agent and Counsellor Training, ICEF Agency Training Course or a PIER qualification.
* Experience with an education CRM (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, ApplyBoard or similar).
* Knowledge of scholarship and education loan options.

**What success looks like**

By day 90 you run your own caseload independently and students would recommend you.

* **First 30 days:** Learn UniEra's partner universities, processes and CRM; shadow senior consultants on live consultations.
* **By day 60:** Take on your own caseload of new leads and submit your first applications.
* **By day 90:** Manage a full caseload; your first students receive offers and begin visa applications.

Ongoing measures: lead-to-enrolment conversion rate, applications submitted, offer and visa approval rates, response time to new enquiries, and student satisfaction scores.

**What we offer**

* Competitive base salary plus incentives for each student enrolled.
* Fully remote work with flexible hours.
* Paid onboarding and ongoing training on destinations, visa rules and partner universities.
* Paid time off and public holidays.
* A clear path to Senior Consultant and Team Lead roles.
* Work alongside consultants who were international students themselves and know the journey first-hand.

**How to apply:**

Click **Apply** to submit your resume. In the optional cover letter, tell us about one student you helped and what you did for them.

**Our hiring process:**

* Application review
* 30-minute intro call with the hiring manager
* Role-play: a mock consultation with a student and parent
* Final interview with the Head of Counseling

UniEra is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a motivated and technically competent Civil Engineer to support the planning, design, coordination, and delivery of infrastructure, mix used development, airports, data centre projects.The role will involve civil engineering design across the project lifecycle, including site development, grading, drainage, roads and pavements, underground utilities, external works, and coordination with structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and other engineering disciplines. The role involves delivering civil engineering design for data centres, industrial, commercial, and infrastructure projects. Responsibilities include site grading, earthworks, roads, pavements, drainage, external works, and utility infrastructure design. The engineer will develop stormwater drainage strategies, coordinate finished levels, utilities, attenuation, and discharge requirements. The role requires preparation and review of calculations, drawings, specifications, technical reports, and design documentation. Coordination with structural, architectural, MEP, BIM, geotechnical, landscape, and other disciplines is essential. The engineer will review surveys, site investigation information, contractor drawings, RFIs, and technical submissions. **About the role**
------------------

The Data Governance Manager manages a team of data governance professionals and oversees the implementation of BT's data governance strategy, driving adherence to related policy and standards, whilst ensuring data remains accurate, consistent, secure, and aligned with strategic objectives.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead the roadmap and operating model for data quality, catalogue, lineage, business glossary and taxonomy controls.
* Manage, coach and set priorities for a team of four, creating clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Define and maintain control requirements, data quality dimensions, rules, thresholds, scorecards and escalation routes for critical data.
* Drive the cataloguing of data assets and critical data elements, including ownership, definitions, classification and lineage.
* Establish and govern enterprise business glossary and taxonomy standards so that data is described consistently across BT.
* Work with Data Owners, Data Stewards, engineering and platform teams to embed controls into data products, pipelines and delivery processes.
* Oversee data quality issue management, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, validation and closure based on business and risk impact.
* Develop dashboards and management information that show control effectiveness, exceptions, trends and areas requiring intervention.
* Maintain clear control evidence and support internal assurance, audit and regulatory reviews.
* Identify opportunities to automate controls and integrate governance requirements into cloud and enterprise data platforms.
* Build adoption through practical guidance, training and engagement with business and technology teams.
* Monitor market, regulatory and technology developments and continuously improve the control framework.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, data controls or a related data-management discipline in a large or complex organisation.
* Experience leading people or multidisciplinary delivery teams, with the ability to set direction, manage priorities and develop capability.
* Practical experience designing or operating data quality controls, including profiling, rules, thresholds, monitoring, issue management and remediation.
* Strong knowledge of data catalogues, metadata, lineage, business glossaries, taxonomies, critical data elements and data ownership or stewardship models.
* Experience translating policy and risk requirements into operational processes, controls, evidence and measurable outcomes.
* Working knowledge of recognised data-management or control frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM, COBIT or equivalent.
* Experience with governance and data-quality platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Ataccama, Dataplex, Databricks, Ab Initio or equivalent.
* Ability to use dashboards and management information to explain control performance, risks and priorities to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across business, engineering, platform, risk, compliance and assurance teams.
* Understanding of privacy, security, records and regulatory expectations relevant to enterprise data, including GDPR.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience embedding or automating governance controls in cloud data platforms, particularly GCP, or through policy-as-code approaches.
* Experience supporting data or AI governance, audit readiness and control assurance in a regulated organisation.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or equivalent reporting tools.
* A relevant degree or professional certification such as DAMA CDMP, DCAM, Microsoft Purview or a recognised cloud data certification.

description:
MongoDB's Analytics team partners across go-to-market and Product to help the business make better decisions. We work with Sales, GTM Operations, FP&A, CRM Technology, and Product teams to connect data at a granular level, understand performance, and identify opportunities to improve how we operate.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll work with business and technical partners to frame questions, deliver reliable analysis, and translate findings into practical recommendations. You'll contribute to analytics and reporting that make complex information easier to understand and act on.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model.

* Partner with Sales, GTM Operations, FP&A, CRM Technology, and Product to understand business questions and shape them into clear analytical work
* Analyze business performance, including pipeline health, funnel movement, productivity, attainment, and other team priorities

* Build and improve dashboards and reporting that help teams monitor performance and investigate changes
* Identify meaningful trends, risks, and opportunities; explain what the analysis does and does not show; and recommend next steps
* Work with data and systems partners to investigate quality issues, clarify definitions, and improve data reliability
* Communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and follow through on whether recommendations are adopted

### **What we're looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related field. We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and strong evidence of relevant skills and impact
* Strong SQL skills are required, including the ability to join and aggregate data, reason about metric definitions, and validate results
* Experience using Python or R for analysis and data manipulation is a plus
* Experience turning business questions into structured analysis and communicating findings to different audiences
* Familiarity with dashboards or data visualization tools; Tableau experience is helpful
* Good data judgment: you check assumptions and data quality, are transparent about limitations, and can distinguish a useful signal from noise
* A collaborative, dependable approach to working with business and technical partners, including when requirements are still taking shape
* Experience in SaaS, go-to-market, sales, finance, or product analytics is helpful, but not required

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

description:

**About the role**
------------------

The Data Governance Manager manages a team of data governance professionals and oversees the implementation of BT's data governance strategy, driving adherence to related policy and standards, whilst ensuring data remains accurate, consistent, secure, and aligned with strategic objectives.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead, coach and develop the Data Reliability Engineering team, setting clear priorities, standards and measurable outcomes.
* Own the reliability requirements for enterprise data pipelines and data products, covering availability, freshness, completeness, performance and recoverability.
* Define and maintain service-level indicators, service-level objectives, alert thresholds, runbooks and operational ownership for critical data services.
* Ensure monitoring, telemetry and automated checks are built into new and migrated data pipelines before live-service acceptance.
* Own the Data Reliability Engineering contribution to service acceptance, challenging handover where monitoring, recovery evidence or accountable ownership is missing.
* Lead the technical response and recovery for significant data-pipeline and data-product incidents, working with SRE, engineering and Service Operations.
* Drive clear root-cause analysis and ensure recurring failures result in structural engineering fixes rather than repeated manual intervention.
* Build and maintain a prioritised reliability backlog, with agreed owners, target dates and evidence of risk reduction.
* Use Cephalopod, Dynatrace and platform-native tooling to improve automated monitoring, control evidence and operational response.
* Identify reliability risks, capacity constraints and manual operational work that can be removed through automation or design change.
* Work with Data Ingestion and Core Engineering to improve pipeline design, orchestration, data-quality controls, deployment patterns and recovery capability.
* Provide clear reporting on data-service health, incidents, recovery performance, recurring failure patterns and improvement progress.
* Support a sustainable operational model, including agreed support coverage, escalation paths and participation in incident or on-call arrangements where required.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience leading data engineering, data reliability, platform operations or production-support teams in a complex organisation.
* Strong understanding of batch and streaming data pipelines, orchestration, data quality, lineage, monitoring and recovery.
* Experience defining service-level indicators, service-level objectives, alerts, runbooks and operational acceptance criteria.
* Strong incident, problem and root-cause management experience, including leading technical recovery across teams.
* Experience using monitoring and operational evidence to prioritise engineering improvements and prevent repeat failure.
* Ability to lead and develop engineers, set clear standards and hold teams accountable for outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management across data engineering, platform engineering, SRE, service operations and business teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise reporting of service risk and performance to senior stakeholders.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform data services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataplex and Cloud Composer.
* Experience with Dynatrace, Google Cloud Monitoring, Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent observability tooling.
* Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering practices, including error budgets, operational toil reduction and blameless learning.
* Experience with data-observability platforms, automated data-quality controls and infrastructure as code.
* Relevant certification in Google Cloud, data engineering, SRE, DevOps or IT service management.

We have transitioned from a traditional, reactive WFM department into a proactive, AI-powered **Resource Orchestration Center (ROC)** organization. Operating as the "Enterprise Brain" of our 1,000-agent, 24/7 global travel operation, we rely on an advanced technology stack—including Genesys Cloud, Snowflake data lakes, ThoughtSpot, and AI-driven analytics—to automate administrative tasks and empower our human talent. We don't just report on what happened; we engineer outcomes to guarantee our elite service level agreements (SLAs) for our travelers and corporate clients.

As a **Service Command Analyst**, you are the tactical controller of our live global travel operations. You will step away from traditional, manual processes and spreadsheet updates. Instead, you will operate in a dynamic, *exception-based* environment. Leveraging real-time, AI-generated alerts and dashboards, you will identify risks before they impact the traveler and execute pre-approved, rapid-response levers to protect the business.

To allow for maximum flexibility and impact, you will not be siloed into a single channel (e.g., "just voice" or "just chat"). Instead, you will act as a **Portfolio Owner** during your shift, managing the holistic health of adaptable business tiers (such as Core, Designated, Dedicated, and Specialty Travel Desks) and adjusting to operational needs as they evolve in the fast-paced travel industry.

**What You'll Do:**

### **Exception-Based Execution & SLA Recovery**

* Monitor automated alerts generated by our Service Intelligence infrastructure indicating SLA risks, volume spikes, or AHT anomalies driven by global travel events.
* Autonomously execute flexible operational levers (e.g., skill blending, channel pivoting, schedule adjustments, or micro-shift overtime) to maintain target SLAs.
* Pivot agents seamlessly between various queues and assignments based on real-time global thresholds and shifting business travel priorities.

### **Portfolio & Queue Ownership**

* Act as the primary operational controller for your assigned portfolios during your regional shift, adapting to volume trends across multiple business lines.
* Ensure highly effective "follow-the-sun" handoffs to your international counterparts to guarantee seamless 24/7 global continuity.

### **Incident & Disruption Management**

* Serve as the tip of the spear during travel and business disruptions (system outages, global flight groundings, weather impacts, natural disasters).
* Command the incident response protocols, issue executive notifications, and dynamically reallocate global staffing resources to mitigate impact on travelers.

### **Strategic Cross-Training & Collaboration**

* Participate in the ROC rotation program, cross-training in forecasting, capacity planning, and basic data intelligence (ThoughtSpot/AI Prompting) to enhance your versatility and eliminate single points of failure.
* Collaborate closely with the Service Intelligence Engineer, BI & Automation Analyst, and Service Excellence Lead to identify repetitive tasks that can be automated out of the Command Center.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **Experience:** 2+ years of progressive experience in Workforce Management, Real-Time Operations, or an Operational Command Center environment. (Experience in the travel industry is a plus and highly preferred).
* **Technical Proficiency:** Deep understanding of modern omnichannel routing platforms; **Genesys Cloud** experience is highly preferred.
* **Data Literacy:** Comfort operating in a modern data ecosystem. Familiarity with navigating data visualization tools (e.g., **ThoughtSpot**, Power BI, Tableau) powered by central data lakes (**Snowflake**).
* **Analytical Agility:** Strong systems-thinking ability. You must be able to digest AI-driven recommendations and quickly decide on the optimal operational lever to pull under pressure, adjusting to new scenarios as they arise.
* **Communication:** Elite communication and interpersonal skills. You will be drafting executive summaries and coordinating rapid responses across multiple global departments.

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job profile-**

We are looking for an experienced **Product Manager** to shape the next generation of our time-series data capability.

Across major infrastructure projects, large volumes of sensor, monitoring and operational data are generated over time. Our Timeseries product enables project teams to bring this information together, connect it with other project data, understand trends and changes, and build data-driven applications and services around it.

You will join our digital product and engineering organisation in India and work with colleagues and project teams around the world.

**Role description**

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a product at an important point in its evolution. We have an established legacy platform supporting real projects and customer use cases, alongside a new cloud-based Timeseries product that we are developing for the future.

Your role will be to understand how our customers and project teams use time-series data today, identify their most important needs, and translate those into a clear product strategy and roadmap for the new platform. Your job will not be to recreate the legacy system feature for feature. You will work with customers, project teams, engineers, architects and other Product Managers to determine:

* what should become part of the core Timeseries product;

* what should be redesigned or simplified;

* what should be enabled through APIs, events and integrations;

* how existing projects can safely transition to the new platform;

* and which legacy capabilities can ultimately be retired.

You will be comfortable working in a technically complex environment while keeping the product focused on user needs, reusable capabilities and measurable outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities** **-**

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our Timeseries product.

* Understand how customers and project teams use time-series, sensor and operational data, and identify the problems that are most valuable for us to solve.

* Lead product discovery with users, project teams, engineers and subject-matter experts, translating their needs into clear product outcomes and priorities.

* Define MVPs and make deliberate decisions about what belongs in the core product and what does not.

* Work closely with the engineering team to maintain a clear, prioritised and delivery-ready product backlog, ensuring upcoming work is understood and aligned to product outcomes.

* Play an active role in the team's agile delivery rhythm, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, maintaining clarity on priorities, outcomes and learning.

* Shape the product capabilities for ingesting, managing, finding, visualising and responding to time-series data, including ingestion, search and alarming.

* Define how Timeseries works with APIs, events and other applications so that specialist project needs don't create unnecessary complexity within the core product.

* Lead the product strategy for transitioning existing projects from our legacy platform, identifying what should be replaced, redesigned, supported differently or retired, and developing a repeatable migration approach.

* Improve onboarding and self-service so project teams can adopt and configure Timeseries without relying on specialist platform knowledge.

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design and other product teams to turn product direction into delivered customer outcomes.

* Define meaningful measures of product adoption, customer value and migration progress.

* Communicate product direction, priorities, decisions and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Candidate Specification**

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who enjoys solving complex product problems and is comfortable working with technical products.

You may currently be working with a data platform, IoT product, analytics platform, developer platform, enterprise SaaS product or another technically complex B2B product.

You do not need to be a software engineer or database specialist. However, you should be technically curious and able to work confidently with engineers and architects, understand the implications of different approaches, and turn technical complexity into clear product decisions.

Most importantly, you will bring strong product judgement. You will be comfortable deciding not only what we should build, but also what we should not build.

Your experience is likely to include several of the following:

* Product strategy, discovery and roadmap ownership.

* B2B, enterprise, platform or data product management.

* Understanding customer and user problems through research and discovery.

* Translating complex needs into product outcomes rather than simply collecting feature requests.

* Defining MVPs and making evidence-based prioritisation and scope decisions.

* Working closely with engineering, architecture and design teams.

* APIs, integrations, data pipelines or other technically complex product capabilities.

* Cloud-based software products.

* Managing products with multiple customer or project use cases.

* Communicating complex product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience leading or contributing to a legacy platform replacement, customer migration, data-platform migration or major product transformation would be particularly valuable.

**Qualifications Preferred** **-**

Experience in some of the following areas would be beneficial, but is not essential:

* time-series databases or time-series data products;

* IoT, sensors, telemetry or operational data;

* Microsoft Azure or other major cloud platforms;

* APIs and SDKs;

* event-driven systems;

* data ingestion and data pipelines;

* data visualisation and analytics;

* alerting or alarming products;

* geospatial or GIS products;

* multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.

We are more interested in finding an excellent Product Manager who is comfortable working with technical products, than somebody who already knows our particular technology stack.

**Further details-**

This role offers the opportunity to shape a product while it is being transformed rather than inheriting one where all the major product decisions have already been made.

You will help us take the best of an established capability, simplify areas that have become complex over time, and establish a modern Timeseries product that can support projects at scale.

You'll have the opportunity to work with real infrastructure use cases and diverse project teams, and to influence how sensor and operational data are used across our digital products in the future.

The successful candidate will ultimately help us answer three important questions:

* What should our Timeseries product become?

* How do we make it simple and valuable for projects to adopt?

* How do we successfully move from the platform we have today to the product we want for the future?

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

**Title: Senior Engineer EHS & Security**

  

**About GF**

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.

  

**Summary of Role:**

The objective of the Environmental, Health, Safety & Security (EHS&S) Engineer is to lead overall safety, environmental, and security operations and compliance for the India & APAC non-manufacturing sites. Geographical scope includes but is not limited to India, China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan and Malaysia. The role promotes a strong safety culture by providing safety and health expertise and ensuring that management systems are established and effectively used to maintain compliance. The ideal candidate will have the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment, possess strong organizational skills with the ability to build professional relationships with numerous inter-dependent teams of different disciplines.

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Work with the site to drive and facilitate a strong safety culture

* Manage and assist with the development and implementation of site-specific EHS&S procedures and programs

* Work with site groups and management to help ensure timely and complete root cause investigations of all EHS&S incidents, as well as timely and sustainable closure of all assigned corrective actions

* Work with teams on hazard identification, evaluation, control and provide appropriate risk mitigation strategies

* Ensure compliance with local and regional EHS&S requirements, laws, regulations, and Global EHS Standards.

* Assist with local and company Sustainability efforts & projects

* Serve as the regional EHS&S point of coordination for India and APAC non-manufacturing stakeholders, aligning Legal, GRE/Facilities, IT, HR, Supply Chain, Labs, site leadership, contractors, consultants, and external agencies on compliance and risk-control actions.

* Participate and lead portions of EHS&S self-assessment and/or audits

* Provide technical assistance and guidance to site population

* Lead EHS&S Management system implementation for the site and assist with the preparation for, completion and coordination of related audits

* Lead and coordinate emergency response, security, business continuity and crisis management efforts for the sites including serving as Incident Commander during site related emergencies, drills/exercises, etc.

* Participate on EHS&S Centers of Excellence (COEs)

* Maintain audit readiness for ISO, RBA, customer, internal, and regulatory audits by coordinating inspections, evidence collection, CAPA tracking, management reviews, and closure verification.

* Provide EHS&S oversight for contractors, consultants, vendors, recyclers, and service providers, including onboarding, access expectations, training, work-scope review, incident reporting, and compliance with GF standards

* Organize and lead Safety Committee Meetings

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs

* Advise project teams on EHS&S criteria during building construction, fit-outs, or office relocations and property decommissioning

* Promote safety awareness through best practice based and mandatory safety inductions, training and campaigns for relevant GF stakeholders like staff, facility vendors, contractors etc.

* Lead and implement digital transformation projects for APAC as applicable

* Perform additional work activities as directed by EHS&S Management
  

**Other Responsibilities:**

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in EHS or Engineering OR Occupational Safety

* Experience – minimum of 5 years of relevant experience

* Travel – Regular travel between GF India sites and 10% travel within the APAC region

* Experience with EHS Management systems and auditing is preferred

* Fluency in English Language – written & verbal

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Strong planning & organizational skills

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Radhakrishna IVF and Multi-speciality Hospital, RR Nagar.  
**Reports To:** COO

Job Summary

The HR Executive – Talent Acquisition & Payroll will be responsible for **recruitment, candidate shortlisting, and payroll processing** for clinical and non-clinical staff across the IVF Centre and Multi-Speciality Hospital. The role requires strong coordination skills, accuracy in payroll management, and thorough understanding of **healthcare HR compliance, staffing structures, and statutory requirements**.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment & Shortlisting

* Source candidates through job portals, internal databases, referrals, consultants, and social media.
* Screen CVs and **shortlist candidates** based on role-specific requirements and hospital standards.
* Conduct initial telephonic/virtual interviews.
* Coordinate interviews with department heads, consultants, and management.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and MIS reports.

Healthcare-Specific Hiring

* Manage recruitment for:
* Doctors, Medical Officers, Embryologists
* Nurses, OT Technicians, Lab & Radiology staff
* Pharmacy, Front Office, Billing, TPA, Admin, Marketing, and Support staff
* Verify credentials including:
* Educational qualifications
* Medical council registrations
* Experience and reference checks
* Ensure compliance with hospital HR policies and confidentiality norms.

Payroll Management

* Process **monthly payroll** for all hospital employees (clinical and non-clinical).
* Collect and verify attendance, duty rosters, leaves, overtime, and on-call allowances.
* Calculate salaries, incentives, night duty allowances, and deductions accurately.
* Ensure timely disbursement of salaries and payslips.
* Address payroll-related employee queries and discrepancies.

Statutory Compliance & Records

* Manage statutory deductions and compliance including:
* PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS
* Coordinate with finance/accounts team for payroll reconciliation.
* Maintain payroll registers, salary structures, and employee cost data.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws and hospital HR policies.

Onboarding & Employee Documentation

* Issue offer letters, appointment letters, and employment contracts.
* Coordinate employee induction and joining formalities.
* Maintain employee personal files, payroll records, and HR documentation.

HR Coordination & Support

* Support HR audits, inspections, and internal reviews.
* Assist in policy implementation, leave management, and attendance systems.
* Generate monthly HR and payroll reports for management review.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong recruitment and **candidate shortlisting skills**
* Hands-on experience in **hospital payroll processing**
* Knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy
* Good communication and employee-handling skills
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and integrity
* Proficiency in MS Excel and HR/payroll software

Qualifications & Experience

* **Graduate/Post-Graduate in HR, Hospital Administration, or related field**
* **2–5 years of experience** in healthcare HR, recruitment, and payroll
* Prior experience in IVF centre or hospital setup preferred
* Knowledge of hospital shift patterns and variable pay structures is an advantage

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of open positions
* Payroll accuracy and on-time salary processing
* Compliance with statutory requirements
* Employee satisfaction with HR and payroll services
* Reduction in payroll errors and hiring delays

Work Environment

* Hospital / IVF Centre setting
* Confidential, compliance-driven role
* Requires coordination with clinical teams and finance department
